name: JAC native work direct deal proof

steps.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()];local cap=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity();local b=GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_ABSORPTION_CACHE'];if not cap:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(b.Index) then cap:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(b.Index,Map.GetPlot(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()):GetIndex(),100) end;p:AttachModifierByID('GOODY_CULTURE_GRANT_ONE_RELIC');Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_OWNER',p:GetID());return 'granted native relic in existing city without creating new cities'

local owner=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_OWNER');local p=Players[owner];local works={};for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do for b in GameInfo.Buildings() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(b.Index) then for slot=0,city:GetBuildings():GetNumGreatWorkSlots(b.Index)-1 do local w=city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(b.Index,slot);if w and w>=0 then works[#works+1]={Index=w,City=city:GetID(),Building=b.Index,Slot=slot,Type=city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkTypeFromIndex(w)} end end end end end;assert(#works==1,'expected one native relic, got '..#works);local data={Owner=owner,Work=works[1],Outgoing=DealDirection.OUTGOING,GreatWork=DealItemTypes.GREATWORK,Free=PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID()};ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeDealData=function() return data end;print('[JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_SETUP] owner='..owner..' work='..works[1].Index..' enact='..type(DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal));return 'actual native relic located '..works[1].Index

local d=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeDealData());local target;for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if p:GetID()~=d.Owner then target=p:GetID();break end end;assert(target);local p=Players[d.Owner];if p:GetDiplomacy().SetHasMet then p:GetDiplomacy():SetHasMet(target) end;DealManager.ClearWorkingDeal(d.Outgoing,d.Owner,target);local deal=assert(DealManager.GetWorkingDeal(d.Outgoing,d.Owner,target));local item=assert(deal:AddItemOfType(d.GreatWork,d.Owner));item:SetSubType(d.Work.Type);item:SetValueType(d.Work.Index);deal:Validate();print('[JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_VALID] '..tostring(deal:IsValid())..' enact='..type(DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal));assert(deal:IsValid(),'native deal invalid');DealManager.EnactWorkingDeal(d.Owner,target);Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_TARGET',target);return 'enacted actual great-work gift to '..target

local d=ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeDealData();local target=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_TARGET');local owner=Game.GetGreatWorkPlayer(d.Work.Index);print('[JAC_NATIVE_DEAL_RESULT] index='..d.Work.Index..' createdBy='..tostring(owner));local found;for _,city in Players[target]:GetCities():Members() do for b in GameInfo.Buildings() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(b.Index) then for slot=0,city:GetBuildings():GetNumGreatWorkSlots(b.Index)-1 do if city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(b.Index,slot)==d.Work.Index then found={City=city:GetID(),Building=b.Index,Slot=slot} end end end end end;assert(found,'native work not physically transferred to target');return 'same native index now belongs to another real faction'
